events.title: Demo Update - Performance improvements
events.summary: This is the last demo update before Steam Next Fest (hopefully). I've been working hard on optimization to make A Game About Cutting Grass run smoother on more PCs, without sacrificing its cozy atmosphere. In my tests, FPS improved significantly, especially in open areas and when looking towards the mountains. events.title: Demo Update – Localization Fix
events.summary: I’ve just released a fix for an issue affecting the demo’s localization files.Unfortunately, due to one tiny missing comma, all languages except Italian were not working correctly. Yes… one comma.I’m really sorry for the issue, and I sincerely thank everyone who reported it and helped me track it down.The problem has now been fixed, and the available localizations should work correctly again.Thank you for playing the demo and for all your feedback!
